text:
sarah_j: Heads up — Quantum Health CIO asked for exec-level review. POC stuck on 3 blockers: Okta SSO, egress encryption proof, and a firm price cap for month 1. Need an internal escalation.
mike_s: +1. They want a written commit that we can provide dedicated capacity for the POC window and a one-month price cap. CFO is asking for a discount but legal needs SSO details first.
ajay_k: I can do the Okta flow. Can I get their IdP metadata? last time it was a custom claim mapping. @olivia_p do we have a SSO runbook I can forward?
olivia_p: Sending the SSO playbook in a sec. It includes the callback URL and attribute map we usually use. Quick note: Quantum Health uses email as the unique identifier (no sub).
emily_p: For egress/encryption: ops wants to see TLS 1.3 + customer-managed KMS for keys. They specifically asked for an RFC-style doc we can share with their infra team.
kevin_r: Ops-bot: attaching network spec template. ```
# Network requirements
- TLS 1.3 enforced
- Customer KMS (AES-256)
- Egress endpoints in us-east-1 only (for POC)
``` 
mike_s: Great. On pricing cap: Sales asked if we can do $X for month 1 with a hard cap and then revert to list pricing. Need an approvals path — who signs off on committed-cap discounts for reserved capacity during POC?
sarah_j: @kevin_r do we have precedent for a 1-month cap tied to a POC? I can escalate to revenue ops but want exec approval first.
kevin_r: Short answer: we can offer a time-limited credit instead of changing list pricing. That avoids contract churn. Finance will need an approval ticket. If execs want to engage, @ajay_k can prepare a short tech appendix.
ajay_k: Will prepare the appendix today. ETA 3pm PT. It will include SSO steps, network controls, and a short runbook for spinning a dedicated pool for the POC.
olivia_p: Legal-bot: Quantum Health also submitted a security questionnaire. There are three deep asks around data residency, log retention, and encryption-at-rest key ownership.
legal-bot: I've started answers for the SQ. Tagging @emily_p for KMS ownership and @kevin_r for log retention policy confirmation.
emily_p: Confirmed: we support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments. For hosted POC we can offer a tenant-isolated key via our KMS with evidence doc.
kevin_r: Logs: default is 30d retention but we can extend to 90d for enterprise customers. Need written request on their letterhead for anything longer for compliance.
mike_s: Proposed immediate plan: 1) @ajay_k finishes tech appendix by 15:00 PT. 2) @emily_p and @kevin_r finalize KMS/log answers by EOD. 3) I escalate pricing ask to Revenue Ops and request exec review. 4) @sarah_j loop in customer execs with proposed commitments.
sarah_j: I'll open the exec-thread and include the revenue ask + risk tradeoffs. Can someone compile a single PDF with SSO appendix, network spec, and SQ answers? Prefer to share a single packet.
ajay_k: I'll assemble the PDF after the appendix; should be ready by 17:30 PT.
legal-bot: Note: any commitments referencing SLA or uptime guarantees > standard must be routed through legal and SRE. Don't promise 99.99% in the packet.
emily_p: Also, be explicit: POC dedicated pool is time-boxed and for evaluation only. Full production requires dedicated contract & infra review.
kevin_r: Ops-bot: I've queued a temporary dedicated pool request template for SRE review. Tagging @sre-oncall as FYI.
sarah_j: Thanks everyone. I'm marking owners: Ajay (tech appendix & PDF), Emily (KMS language), Kevin (logs & ops template), Mike (pricing escalation), Olivia (SSO runbook). I'll post a short status update to the customer after exec sync.
mike_s: Please cc me on the exec note. If we can get verbal sign from their CIO after we send the packet, we can lock a 2-week kickoff window.
ajay_k: PDF draft uploaded to the sales drive: https://redwood.example/sales/qhc-poc-packet (internal link)
sarah_j: Closing note — keep replies short in this thread. If any blocker slips, ping me directly. :eyes:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: SRE ticket #SRE-4521 created for temporary pool review.
legal-bot: legal ticket #LEGAL-789 ready for approval.
mike_s: Thanks team — will chase revenue ops now and update in this thread.
sarah_j: Last update: exec call scheduled 16:30 PT. I'll share outcome here after the call.
